previous_visual_review.observations: The viewer diagnosis remains “Источник не публикует аудиодорожку.” in desktop and mobile captures. During mobile DM navigation, the screen-share notice sits between the mini-player and conversation header, leaving the composer send button clear. Voluntary voice leave uses a neutral status treatment on desktop and mobile. The real-stack mini-player stays present across TEXT/DM state at 1440px and 393px. The 393px share statistics distinguish the selected sender profile from measured receiver dimensions and mark unavailable measurements as stale/absent; these captures do not establish media quality or capacity.  Twenty more unique component-fixture captures were inspected at source resolution across two passes. Responsive shell at 320px and 1440px retained its composer and voice status; the 320px DM list, 1440px channel list and 320px archive controls stayed within their panels; desktop audio diagnostics remained in-frame; channel administration forms fit at 390px and 1440px; the 2× mobile screen-share settings retained the fixed action footer, while the desktop 2× dialog retained its options and actions; and the mini-player DM at 320px kept the composer and voice dock visible. At 1440px with 200% text, the mini-player and message composer remained visible while long sidebar labels were clipped within their rails. The synthetic captures show layout only and do not prove media quality or user acceptance.

previous_run_review_snapshot.observations: The screen-share diagnosis remains “Источник не публикует аудиодорожку.” in desktop and 390px/200% text captures while receiver samples move from absent to fresh to stale; its focused browser regression asserts the exact text at all three states. The 1024px/200% launch and quality dialogs, plus the 637x584 quality selection capture, keep their frames and primary actions visible; the larger dialogs scroll their detail text within the frame. At 390px the receiver drawer keeps the summary and copy action readable, the expanded technical details continue below the capture, and the unsupported-browser warning and profile controls fit; a close-action hint appears beside the close icon. The 320px/200% voice prejoin card fits its two actions while the room title truncates in the header. At 390px/200% the microphone-denied status wraps above the fixed voice controls, which remain visible. A 320px/200% DM header truncates its title but keeps actions visible; search tabs stack vertically with no horizontal overflow, while the query placeholder is clipped by the narrow field. The 320px/200% DM picker stays within the viewport, though a deliberately pathological synthetic name wraps across many lines. At 390px/200% the mini-player and composer remain visible; a long draft wraps and scrolls to its active line, and the focused regression checks one-line draft visibility and retention across navigation. These are synthetic UI fixtures and do not prove physical picker or media quality.
